senses.gloss: 1. कु a pronom. base appearing in कु॑तस्, कु॑त्र, कुवि॑द्, कु॑ह, क्व॑, and as a prefix implying deterioration, depreciation, deficiency, want, littleness, hindrance, reproach, contempt, guilt
as a separate word कु occurs only in the lengthened form 3. कू॑, q.v.
2. कु f. the earth, Āryabh.; VarBṛS.; VarBṛ.; BhP. vi, 1, 42
the ground or base of a triangle or other plane figure, Comm. on Āryabh.

1. कू or कु cl. 2. P. कौति (Ved. कवीति, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 95), or cl. 1. Ā. कवते (Dhātup. xxii, 54), or cl. 6. कुवते (ib. xxviii, 108), or cl. 9. P. Ā. कूनाति or कुनाति, कूनाते or कुनाते (perf. 3. pl. चुकुवुर्, Bhaṭṭ.),
to sound, make any noise, cry out, moan, cry (as a bird), coo, hum (as a bee) &c., Bhaṭṭ. : cl. 1. क॑वते, to move, Naigh. ii, 14 :
Intens. Ā. कोकूयते (Nir.; Pāṇ.), P. Ā. कोकवीति and चोकूयते (Pāṇ. vii, 4, 63, Kāś.),
to cry aloud, Bhaṭṭ.;
 [cf. Gk. κωκύω.]
2. कू॑ ind. (= क्व॑) where? RV. v, 74, 1.
3. कू f. a female Piśāca or goblin, L.
